V1.31.description:
- New Shopmode! Like many Roguelike/Roguelite/Whateverlite games we have now the shopmode, become stronger with every iteration! Buy units and buff them BEFORE the mission starts! 10 missions need to be beaten with choices, rewards, and increased difficulties depending on the path you take! 

Bugfixes:
- Zero Signal issue
- Red Dawn unit transfer 
- Add Randomizer Label for missing units
- remove assistance buff for explosion units (So they do not explode in your army)
- Fix weapon switch units (They turned into their original unit type)
- Earthrise and Noise Severe fixes with unit transfer and duplicated unit access
- Fix old demo truck, ivan cadet and ivan bike, range buff.
- Fix Chaos access to buildings (Capturing an enemy MCV did not allow you to build defenses e.g.)
- T1 units given incorrectly in chaos/standard/shop
- Yuri Prime cloning vets removal (Broke the queue and cloning vets production)
- Fix Buff of enemy AI killing units they are not supposed to kill (Shipwreck Humvee sniped the engineer softlocking the mission)
V1.31.title: Release 1.31
